summary: Argentina defeats France in a tense penalty shootout, with Emiliano Martínez's pivotal saves and Gonzalo Montiel's decisive kick securing victory; Lionel Messi achieves career-defining triumph, celebrated as a national hero.

video_highlights.highlight: The scene opens with an overhead view of a soccer stadium during a penalty shootout, referencing France's historical loss at the European Championships.
Kingsley Coman's penalty kick is saved by Emiliano Martínez, with the crowd's whistles amplifying the tension.
Gonzalo Montiel scores the decisive penalty, securing Argentina's victory as fans celebrate with sky-blue and white scarves.
The commentator reflects on Argentina's historic win, declaring it "a nation's new throne of immortals" and highlighting Messi's sainthood.
The audio celebrates Messi's career-defining triumph, describing him as "the boy from Rosario Santa Fe" who has "pitched up in heaven."

suggested_clips.description: A goalie reacts emotionally as the ball moves into the goal, capturing the tension and drama of the penalty shootout.
Kingsley Coman's penalty kick is saved by Emiliano Martínez, showcasing a pivotal moment in the shootout.
